name: Degoog
description: Degoog is a self-hosted search engine aggregator that queries multiple search engines and shows results in one place. It supports custom search engines, bang-command plugins, query-triggered slot plugins, and pluggable transports (curl, FlareSolverr, etc). Set a settings password before exposing this to the internet, since an unlocked instance lets anyone install extensions that run code on the server.

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Stores engines, plugins, themes, transports, and other on-disk state.

variables.name: Settings Password
variables.description: Comma-separated list of passwords for the settings page. Set this before exposing the instance to the internet; unlocked instances allow anyone to install extensions.

variables.name: Public Instance
variables.description: Run in public mode with restricted settings access, for shared/public-facing instances.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the container process runs as.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the container process runs as.
